# Source and license

Selected db.py and media.py modules from
https://github.com/fanyuantaier/wechatauto-replica (Apache-2.0).
The original local snapshot did not record an upstream commit. Original headers
and LICENSE are retained. Integration is maintained outside this directory.
The public export anonymizes sample identifiers in db.py; its own header notes
this modification. There are no behavioral changes to the vendored reader.
